profile.headline: Research Software Engineer
profile.summary: Experienced software engineer with a demonstrated history of working in high performance computing and research environments. Received a Bachelor of Science from Purdue University in Mathematics.

positions.title: Research Support & System Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: OpenStack · Kubernetes · High Performance Computing (HPC) · Python (Programming Language) · Django · Slurm Workload Manager · Bash · Linux System Administration · Software Development · Infrastructure Technologies · Research Computing · Platform Architecture

company.name: University of Chicago, Research Computing Center

positions.title: Research Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Infrastructure developer for I-GUIDE, a web-based geospatial research platform, collaborating closely with scientists to design and deploy scalable services.
• Manage Kubernetes and OpenStack clusters for geospatial data workflows.
• Led full-stack development of Science-i, a forestry data-sharing platform that serves over 300 researchers, with a Python-based API for handling data to over 60 countries, and a hub built with PHP, HTML/CSS, and JavaScript.
• Mentored student developers in the design and implementation of a relational database and data pipeline for geospatial data.
• Serve as a key point of contact between researchers and engineering, along with translating research needs into actionable, production-grade solutions.
• Applied ITIL Foundations to improve system reliability through streamlined incident and change management processes.
positions.insights: Skills: Kubernetes · OpenStack · Full-Stack Development · IT Infrastructure Management · Python (Programming Language) · Ansible · Terraform · Anaconda · Bash · Linux System Administration · Infrastructure Technologies · Information Technology Infrastructure · Research Computing · Technical Publication · Public Speaking · Mentoring · MySQL · PHP · JavaScript · HTML · CSS · jQuery

company.name: Purdue's Rosen Center for Advanced Computing (RCAC)

positions.title: High Performance Computing / Cloud Intern
positions.description:
• Directed the migration and benchmarking of scientific computing workloads from NASA’s supercomputer to Amazon Web Services (AWS) in preparation for cluster downtime during system upgrades.
• Worked directly with users from NASA Goddard, NOAA, and NASA GISS to port and configure their models on AWS HPC instances.
• Configured and optimized AWS-based HPC environments while evaluating performance across multiple filesystems, including EFS, FSx for Lustre, and local NFS with spinning disk.
• Automated complex benchmarking pipelines using Bash and Python, testing workload performance under varying conditions such as RAM, core counts, and storage backends.
• Analyzed and documented the cost and performance tradeoffs between AWS and an on-premises HPC cluster, with findings presented to NASA engineers and stakeholders.
• Authored internal documentation to support other teams onboarding to cloud HPC systems, covering application installation, compiler configurations, and MPI setup.
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Parallel Computing · IT Benchmarking · Cloud Computing · Bash · File Systems · Lustre · GPFS · Cloud Storage · Ubuntu · Spack · Technical Writing · Technical Presentations · Knowledge Sharing

positions.title: High Performance Computing Intern
positions.description:
• Investigated and benchmarked remote visualization protocols to support Linux-based graphical workloads on NASA’s HPC cluster.
• Installed, configured, and tested remote desktop services across HPC environments, analyzing frame rate, network bandwidth, and latency under various load conditions.
• Operated under strict federal cybersecurity protocols and evaluated each solution’s compatibility with NASA’s security standards and excluding non-compliant options.
• Delivered findings in a technical presentation to engineers and stakeholders, highlighting the tradeoffs between user experience, bandwidth usage, and implementation complexity.
positions.insights: Skills: Slurm Workload Manager · Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP) · Cybersecurity · Technical Data Analysis · Security Compliance · Network Monitoring Tools · Network Security · High Performance Computing (HPC) · SUSE Linux Enterprise Server (SLES) · Linux Server · Linux Desktop · Unix Administration · Unix Security

positions.title: High Performance Computing Intern
positions.description:
• Designed containers for NASA/NOAA climate models that resolve platform-specific dependencies and enable HPC portability beyond their supercomputer.
• Orchestrated performance benchmarking across multiple Linux-based containers versus bare-metal installations, achieving a 15% reduction in runtime using bleeding edge containers
• Resolved critical workflow bugs in GEOS through collaboration with maintainers, ensuring cross-platform stability and compatibility.
• Authored comprehensive documentation for container workflows, streamlining deployment processes and best practices for NASA/NOAA researchers.
positions.insights: Skills: Singularity · MPI · Debugging · C (Programming Language) · GNU Make · GNU Compiler Collection (GCC) · Intel Compilers · Data Analysis · Git · Debian · Fedora · CentOS · Technical Documentation · Microsoft Teams · Microsoft Outlook

positions.title: Student Member
positions.description: This is a learning community where students take classes in statistics and data science. I had the opportunity to use various tools like SQL and R on terabytes worth of data from companies. Most of this was done on the high performance computing clusters at Purdue University.
positions.insights: Skills: RStudio · R (Programming Language) · Data Analysis · SQL · Linux · High Performance Computing (HPC) · Collaborative Problem Solving

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
• Designed Docker containers to replace legacy virtual machines for CHEESEhub’s cybersecurity training platform, enabling lightweight exploit simulations via Jupyter Notebooks.
• Built and maintained Docker configurations on GitHub, ensuring consistent access to cybersecurity training environments for instructors and students.
• Collaborated with instructors to align container functionality with training objectives, tailoring environments for hands-on student exercises.
• Audited and patched security flaws in existing containers to mitigate risks while preserving compatibility with interactive lab workflows.
• Documented container setup processes for instructors and developers, clarifying best practices for maintaining and updating training modules.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Shell Scripting · Docker · C (Programming Language) · Linux · Git · Docker Products · GitHub · Research · Poster Presentations · Unix
